name: Mara Quill
source_profile: ● Mara Quill (LG) is a senior investigator renowned for her patience, perceptiveness, and unwavering commitment to uncovering the truth. She genuinely believes the agency can provide justice where local authorities have failed, but increasingly questions the morality of certain contracts accepted by its leadership.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 43 (source excerpt; may be partial)
